integrity: The lower bound combines two forced endpoint landmarks with nested prefix and suffix families of mixed-code obstructions. At equality, those inequalities force exactly one selected vertex from each internal diagonal pair. The sufficiency proof resolves same-side vertices, edge pairs, and the only residual vertex-edge collision families explicitly. The verifier independently computes all vertex-edge distance vectors and exhausts every subset of size at most the claimed minimum for 2 <= n <= 8.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the canonical half graph, not arbitrary chain graphs with repeated neighborhood classes.
It classifies all minimum mixed generators but not all larger mixed generators.
Finite exhaustive verification covers 2 <= n <= 8 and is corroborative only.
The accessible route to the 2021 chain-graph metric-dimension paper exposed bibliographic metadata and abstract but not the full article text.
A differently phrased or non-indexed mixed-metric treatment remains a residual originality risk.
title: Mixed metric bases of half graphs
